research_rationale:
EO 12490 (National Commission on Space), signed 1984-10-12. The order establishes the National Commission on Space (Section 1), its study and report functions (Section 2; the plan and recommendations are due within 12 months of the order, later 18 months), administration (Section 3) and general provisions (Section 4). Section 4(b) ends the Commission 60 days after it submits the report required by Section 2(b), which is report-relative and not a dated end. First end: Section 3(a) of EO 12610 (Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees, signed 1987-09-30, 52 FR 36901-36902) names Executive Order No. 12490 among the orders revoked, and Section 5 makes that order effective September 30, 1987, so the revocation took effect on 1987-09-30. The same section describes the listed orders as ones that established committees which have terminated or whose work is completed; that recital is disclosed as context and as a possible earlier cessation, but it gives no date and is not an end.
